column1: # Book 3 second-round read (Fable, 2026-10-30): every line read against the Latin. No changes.
# 3.1069 the man is the subject of haeret as of odit: he clings to the self he cannot escape.
# 3.1077 quae mala ... tanta cupido is one noun phrase.
# 3.1078 certe is an adverb; "fixed" was a second, adjectival rendering of it.

column2: he cannot escape; he clings to it against his will, and hates it,
what great and evil craving for life compels us?
